assumptions.cipher_suite: TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 (Finished 48 B) when the KEM is Category 5, else TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 (32 B)
assumptions.client_hello: SNI www.example.com, 3 suites, 5 groups, 10 sig schemes, 1 hybrid key share (X25519||ML-KEM), 32-B legacy_session_id (compat), one 32-B trust anchor id (draft-ietf-tls-trust-anchor-ids)
assumptions.x509: DER v3: 20-B serial, 9-B algorithm OIDs (NIST arc; assumed for schemes without one), C/O/CN names, UTCTime, SKI/AKI 20 B, KU, EKU, SAN, OCSP AIA; chain = leaf + 1 intermediate; ECDSA sizes taken raw (64 B)
assumptions.mtc: Assertion{subject_type u16, TLSSubjectInfo{scheme u16, public_key<1..2^16-1>}, Claim{dns names}} + Proof{trust_anchor<1..2^8-1> (12 B), proof_data<0..2^16-1> = index u64, landmark u32, path<0..2^16-1>}; CertificateEntry carries a trust_anchors ext with the batch id
assumptions.records: ServerHello plaintext record, 6-B compat CCS, one AEAD record (5+1+16 B) per <=2^14-B fragment of each later message
assumptions.quic: Initial: 30-B long header (DCID/SCID 8/8, empty token, 2-B length, 4-B pkt no) + 16-B tag; Handshake: 29 + 16; 5-B ACK frame in the first server Initial; datagrams holding an Initial are capped and padded to 1,200 B, later ones 1,252 (v4) / 1,232 (v6)
assumptions.kemtls: server first flight = SH, EE, Certificate; NO CertificateVerify and NO Finished (server Finished follows the client's KEM ciphertext); client 2nd flight carries ClientKemCiphertext + Finished

model_discrepancies.measured: no Finished in the first flight (server Finished follows the client KEM ciphertext); the client 2nd flight carries ClientKemCiphertext+Finished
NOT ENCODABLE: MTC TLSSubjectInfo.public_key is opaque<1..2^16-1>; a 446,992-B key overflows
exceeds one 1,200-B Initial datagram: the server spends 2 padded Initial datagrams (2,400 B) of the 7,200-B budget on ServerHello

games.winning_condition: n/a: both parties must accept with equal keys

games.attacker_capabilities: controls the network; holds all public keys, ciphertexts and transcripts; oracle access to honest client and server; substitutes its own ephemeral KEM key share and re-encapsulates (knows both ephemeral secrets)
games.winning_condition: client accepts a key the adversary knows, or server accepts the honest client Finished on a split transcript
games.mechanism_that_blocked_it: server authentication = decapsulation of ct_S under pk_S (only the server holds sk_S) + Finished over the full transcript
games.assumption_invoked: IND-CCA of the long-term KEM; collision resistance of the transcript hash

games.outcome: BLOCKED: pk_S -> pk_A, proof unchanged: client: bad_certificate (inclusion proof fails) | pk_S -> pk_A, proof from A's own batch-1 cert: client: bad_certificate (inclusion proof fails)
games.mechanism_that_blocked_it: Merkle inclusion proof binds (claims, pk) as one leaf under a trusted batch root
games.assumption_invoked: second-preimage resistance of H; CA root distribution

games.attacker_capabilities: controls the network; holds all public keys, ciphertexts and transcripts; oracle access to honest client and server; flips one byte of any field of any message
games.winning_condition: the honest party receiving a modified message accepts
games.outcome: BLOCKED: 13 single-field mutations across 7 messages all rejected by the receiver
games.mechanism_that_blocked_it: Finished MACs over the hash of the full transcript; implicit rejection for altered ciphertexts; proof check for altered certs
games.assumption_invoked: PRF security of HMAC-SHA3; collision resistance of SHA3-256

games.attacker_capabilities: controls the network; holds all public keys, ciphertexts and transcripts; oracle access to honest client and server; recorded a full previous session INCLUDING that client's ephemeral secret key and all derived keys
games.winning_condition: new client accepts the replayed server flight
games.outcome: BLOCKED: forwarded to server: server: decrypt_error (client Finished MAC) | forged Finished from old keys: client: decrypt_error (server Finished MAC)
games.mechanism_that_blocked_it: client freshness: ct_e was encapsulated to the OLD ephemeral pk (new sk decapsulates to an implicit-rejection key) and ss_S is fresh per session
games.assumption_invoked: IND-CCA of both KEMs; fresh client randomness

games.attacker_capabilities: controls the network; holds all public keys, ciphertexts and transcripts; oracle access to honest client and server; removes the Category-5 group from the offer and supplies a Cat-3 key share
games.winning_condition: a handshake completes on the Cat-3 group
games.outcome: BLOCKED: delete Cat-5 group: client: illegal_parameter (selected group has no key share) | delete Cat-5 group and rewrite SH.group back: server: decrypt_error (client Finished MAC)
games.mechanism_that_blocked_it: client policy (selected group must be the one it sent a key share for) AND the ClientHello bytes are in both transcripts
games.assumption_invoked: collision resistance of the transcript hash

games.attacker_capabilities: controls the network; holds all public keys, ciphertexts and transcripts; oracle access to honest client and server; IS server b.example (holds sk_B and a valid cert/proof for b.example)
games.winning_condition: client connecting to a.example accepts b.example's certificate
games.outcome: BLOCKED: client: bad_certificate (hostname not in assertion claims)
games.mechanism_that_blocked_it: hostname binding: the SNI hostname must appear in the assertion's dns claims (the ONLY barrier: all MACs verify)
games.assumption_invoked: the CA only certifies names the applicant controls

games.winning_condition: client accepts a cert not issued under a trusted root
games.outcome: BLOCKED: rogue batch, unknown trust anchor: client: unknown_ca (trust anchor id not in store) | rogue assertion under the legit trust anchor id: client: bad_certificate (inclusion proof fails) | rogue assertion with the legit proof: client: bad_certificate (inclusion proof fails)
games.mechanism_that_blocked_it: trust-anchor id lookup + Merkle inclusion proof against the stored root
games.assumption_invoked: root distribution is authentic; second-preimage resistance of H

part_c.axes_note: B (bytes on the wire, Part A) and T (server CPU, Part C) are independent axes reported separately; no combined score is formed.

refuted_hypotheses: H1 "exact framing flips a fits/does-not-fit verdict": refuted — 0 verdict changes; |delta| <= 132 B against 7,200 / 14,600-B budgets
H2 "the KEMTLS server first flight carries a Finished" (model): refuted — the server Finished follows the client KEM ciphertext
H3 "the ServerHello fits one Initial packet" (implicit in a flat byte budget): refuted — 2 padded Initial datagrams for any ML-KEM hybrid
H4 "OV-V (447-KB pk) can be an MTC subject": refuted — TLSSubjectInfo.public_key is bounded by 2^16-1
H5 "hostname binding is redundant given the Finished MACs": refuted — with the check off, server B is accepted for A with equal keys (S3-016)
axes: B (bytes) from Part A and T (CPU) from Part C are reported separately.
